description: This Java class defines a custom exception ResourceNotFoundException used in a Spring application to represent HTTP 404 Not Found errors for missing resources.

classes.name: ResourceNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a requested resource was not found, mapped to HTTP 404 status.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific detail message.
